:::{#sol-sample-factorization}

The [observations](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-observation) are
[independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-independence),
so the joint [mass function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pmf)
multiplies the individual mass functions.
Each factor has the form of @eq-exponential-family:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\pdf\paren{\vx ; \natparam}
&= \prodin \pdf\paren{\rvar_\iobs ; \natparam}
&& \text{(independent observations)}\\
&= \prodin \basemeasuref{\rvar_\iobs} \, \expf{\natparam \, \statf{\rvar_\iobs} - \logpartitionf{\natparam}}
&& \text{(definition of an exponential family)}\\
&= \prodin \basemeasuref{\rvar_\iobs} \prodin \expf{\natparam \, \statf{\rvar_\iobs} - \logpartitionf{\natparam}}
&& \text{(a product of two-factor terms is the product of the first factors times the product of the second factors)}\\
&= \prodin \basemeasuref{\rvar_\iobs} \, \expf{\sumin \paren{\natparam \, \statf{\rvar_\iobs} - \logpartitionf{\natparam}}}
&& \text{(the product of exponentials is the exponential of the sum)}\\
&= \prodin \basemeasuref{\rvar_\iobs} \, \expf{\sumin \natparam \, \statf{\rvar_\iobs} - \sumin \logpartitionf{\natparam}}
&& \text{(the sum of a difference is the difference of the sums)}\\
&= \prodin \basemeasuref{\rvar_\iobs} \, \expf{\natparam \sumin \statf{\rvar_\iobs} - \sumin \logpartitionf{\natparam}}
&& \text{(a factor free of the index moves out of the sum)}\\
&= \prodin \basemeasuref{\rvar_\iobs} \, \expf{\natparam \sumin \statf{\rvar_\iobs} - n \, \logpartitionf{\natparam}}
&& \text{(a sum of } n \text{ equal terms is } n \text{ times the term)}\\
&= \expf{\natparam \sumin \statf{\rvar_\iobs} - n \, \logpartitionf{\natparam}} \prodin \basemeasuref{\rvar_\iobs}
&& \text{(multiplication is commutative)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
